profile.headline: Software Engineer at Sammons Financial Group Companies
profile.summary: Experienced full stack developer with a passion for design. Interested Node.js and new technologies.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Full stack web developer with interest in Node.js and new technologies.

positions.title: Solution Analyst Intern
positions.description:
Worked with team members to manage data and perform data integration and analysis on different projects in Project Management, Analysis, Monitoring and Administration.
•	Planned, developed and implemented a system for monitoring the progress of research throughout the production cycle to support more timely production tracking.
•	Created reusable logic to increase coverage of a valued attribute for a large financial services client by 80%.
•	Assisted Project Managers with planning, tracking, coordinating and executing of projects with team members in order to deliver projects according to plan.
•	Performed data analysis and investigation on various data sets using DataStage, SQL and Excel.
•	Developed and implemented ETL logic for transforming, integrating and aligning data to and existing dataset.

positions.title: Data Research Analyst Intern
positions.description:
Performed research on national and international entities and securities to increase data quality.
•	Researched corporations and securities and provided data about each entity and relationships.
•	Monitored and updated tracked securities, entities and their relationships.
•	Performed research with SEC website for United States companies.
•	Verified bankruptcies, mergers, acquisitions, and dissolutions.
•	Assisted in special project to map postal codes to towns and cities in foreign countries.

educations.schoolName: Iowa State University - Ivy College of Business

honors.title: Group Governor's Volunteer Award
honors.description: I worked in a group that aided in the development on the "What's Your 50?" project website for the state of Iowa.  Our group was selected to receive this award for our work.
